_source: Civic cadences and Academy dates come from .remember/SCHEDULE.md and .remember/academy-material/ACADEMY_SCHEDULE.md, both confirmed with Jerry. Nothing here is a guessed date. Upkeep items come from the 2026-08-28 security audit. Edit this file to add your own; the dashboard reads it live.

groups.label: Covington
groups.blurb: Public meetings worth being in the room for.

groups.label: Keeping it running
groups.blurb: Dull, and the reason nothing breaks.

groups.label: You
groups.blurb: The things that get dropped first.

routines.title: Board of Commissioners meeting
routines.detail: 6:00 PM at City Hall, 20 W. Pike St. Alternates caucus and legislative weeks. Worth going even on a quiet agenda — being a familiar face is most of it.

routines.title: Read the Commissioners agenda before the meeting
routines.detail: Agendas post ahead of the meeting. Look for public-input items — rezoning, budget, hearings. Ten minutes now is the difference between attending and participating.

routines.title: Draft a Civic Field Note from the last meeting
routines.detail: Ryder owns this series and works from get_civic_voice_guide. Fact, attribution and opinion stay separate; never round "advanced from caucus" up to "approved".

routines.title: Kenton County Planning Commission meeting
routines.detail: 6:15 PM, Kenton County Government Center, 1840 Simon Kenton Way, 2nd floor. Monthly, first Thursday.

routines.title: Covington Farmers Market
routines.detail: 9 AM–1 PM on Washington St between W. 6th and W. Pike. Seasonal — runs to Oct 31. Not work. Good place to be seen and to actually talk to people.

routines.title: Mayor's Academy session
routines.detail: 6:00 PM. Speakers and venue vary by session — see .remember/academy-material/ACADEMY_SCHEDULE.md for the full table.

routines.title: Capture notes from the last Academy session
routines.detail: Same pattern as ACADEMY_SESSION_1_NOTES.md. Do it while it's fresh — the details that make a good note are gone within a day.

routines.title: Back up .remember/ somewhere that isn't the Pi
routines.detail: Journal, task board, sessions and team log all live in one gitignored directory on one USB drive. Encrypted copy, off the box, then actually restore it once. This is the difference between "kept for life" and "kept until the drive dies".

routines.title: Confirm the dashboard still requires a password
routines.detail: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4405/healthz — should say `ok auth=password`. It's on the public internet through the tunnel, so this is the one that matters.

routines.title: Run pnpm mcp:doctor and fix whatever it flags
routines.detail: Catches drift before it becomes a broken morning: missing deps, typecheck failures, a dashboard misconfigured for exposure.

routines.title: Check the AI Gateway spend and cap
routines.detail: Eight agents bill to one key on an always-on box. A stuck retry loop is an open tab on your card, and the invoice is how you'd find out.

routines.title: Downgrade Vercel to Hobby before the trial converts
routines.detail: Hobby is free and covers everything this site does. Pro is $20/user/month. Set this task's due date to your trial end — it converts silently.

routines.title: Rotate DASHBOARD_PASSWORD and the session secret
routines.detail: It gates shell access to the repo from the public internet. Rotating on a schedule beats rotating after you need to.

routines.title: Daily check-in
routines.detail: Say "check-in" to Ryder. It's the one conversation that isn't about a task — how the week actually went, what's coming, anything worth writing about later.

routines.title: Appointment
routines.detail: Doctor, dentist, anything with a time on it. Stays on the dashboard — personal appointments never reach the public site.

routines.title: Review finished work and publish CHANGELOG.md
routines.detail: Everything you've checked off is waiting in the Changelog tab. Reviewing it is also the easiest way to notice you got more done than it felt like.
